Cloudflare Connect 2026 · GitHub competition finalist

How Weft
actually
got built.

John Nelson · product engineer, between jobs · La Barra, Uruguay

I didn't write the code.
Agents did.

I asked the questions, made the decisions, and directed the work.
Weft coordinated the agents that built it.

Oct 3 · 8:45 PMStep 1 · explore

“They want ‘the next GitHub’. What does that mean? Are they conflating git with GitHub?”

Why aren’t git worktrees the easy answer? Agents find out about each other at merge time. Too late.

Oct 3 · 8:49 PMStep 4 · alternatives

“Why is it not the obvious answer?”

Jujutsu still records history after the fact. Nothing warns two agents before they collide.

Oct 3 · 9:17 PMStep 2 · specifics

“An agent uses a ‘tool’, correct? These changes happen in a sequence.”

Check every edit as it happens. Send the warning back into the agent’s run.

Oct 3 · 9:21 PMStep 3 · solutions

“Think about the little red squiggles.”
“…sort of like a pre-commit hook.”

An agent gets an error: another agent just changed this function. Here’s the change.

Oct 3 · 9:32 PMSteps 5–6 · decide, edge cases

“A combined event queue that has strict ordering.”
“What’s it called… ‘elect’??”

Consensus. Decide which edit came first; the order settles every argument.

Oct 3 · 9:51 PMa standard

“Are there not tool call hooks with other harnesses? …a new shared standard, like MCP!”

Hooks existed. No shared standard. That became WCP, the Weft Coordination Protocol.

Oct 3 · 9:57–10:20 PMSteps 7–9 · delegate

“Spec this all out in a new Kanban board… a heartbeat agent… like a project manager.”
“Make decisions… without my intervention.”
“We have to assume the code editor disappears in the future.”

Then the agents built it.

Oct 6“I liked the video.
Ship it.” Submitted.

Agents worked in parallel. Their edits went through Weft.

Cloudflare, in plain words

Durable Objectone tiny server + database per repo. Exactly one copy, so it keeps the order. My “elect”, built in.
Artifactsthe git storage
Workersthe web service: the API agents call, and the site
